title: ZXSpace Power-Ups
description: Complete guide to every ZXSpace power-up, including Double Laser, Triple Laser, Piercing Laser, Hull Repair, Shield Repair, EMP Pulse, Smart Bomb, and Score Multiplier.
summary: Master every ZXSpace power-up, learn when to use each one, and discover how player-specific and shared-world abilities can turn the tide of battle.

referenceImage.alt: ZXSpace power-ups showing five player-specific and three shared-world effects

sections.heading: Two Types of Power-Up
paragraphs: ZXSpace power-ups are divided into player-specific and shared-world effects. Player-specific power-ups affect only the cannon that collects them, while shared-world power-ups affect the whole battlefield.
Collect the right power-up at the right moment to strengthen your attack, protect your defences, or turn a dangerous wave back in your favour.

sections.heading: How Power-Ups Appear
paragraphs: Power-ups appear during gameplay after defeated enemies drop them. Stay alert for falling pickups and collect them before they leave the screen.
Some power-ups can completely change the outcome of a difficult wave, so positioning your cannon to collect them safely is an important part of mastering ZXSpace.

sections.heading: Player-Specific Power-Ups
paragraphs: These five power-ups affect only the player who collects them.
bullets: Double Laser — Fires two lasers for 9 seconds. Best used during heavy enemy waves.
Triple Laser — Fires three lasers for 6 seconds. Excellent against dense enemy formations.
Piercing Laser — Lasers pass through multiple enemies for 7 seconds, making it ideal for lined-up attacks.
Hull Repair — Restores one point of the collecting cannon's hull. Most valuable after taking damage.
Score Multiplier — Doubles the collecting player's score for 10 seconds. Collect it before large enemy groups for maximum points.

sections.heading: Shared-World Power-Ups
paragraphs: These three power-ups affect the entire battlefield and benefit every player.
bullets: Shield Repair — Restores a portion of the city's shields, giving everyone more time to defend it.
EMP Pulse — Clears enemy projectiles and stuns enemies for 3 seconds, creating valuable breathing room.
Smart Bomb — Destroys enemy projectiles while damaging every remaining enemy on the screen, making it perfect during overwhelming attacks.

sections.heading: Use Every Advantage
paragraphs: Use Double Laser, Triple Laser, and Piercing Laser during the busiest enemy waves to maximise their damage and clear threats quickly.
Hull Repair and Shield Repair become increasingly valuable later in a game when every point of health can decide whether a city survives.
EMP Pulse and Smart Bomb are powerful emergency tools. Saving them for the most dangerous moments can rescue a city that is close to falling.

questions.question: Do power-ups stack?
questions.answer: Each power-up lasts for its own duration. Collecting another power-up refreshes or replaces the active effect depending on its type.

questions.question: Can both players use power-ups in co-op?
questions.answer: Player-specific power-ups affect only the player who collects them, while shared-world power-ups benefit the entire battlefield.

questions.question: Which power-up is the strongest?
questions.answer: There is no single best power-up. The most effective choice depends on the current wave and the state of the battlefield.
